basics.name: Kevin Kim
basics.label: Bioinformatician & Cryo-EM Data Analyst
basics.summary: Bioinformatics graduate student with experience in cryo-EM reconstruction, RNA-seq analysis, and AI/ML tooling for molecular biology.

work.name: Massachusetts General Hospital, Harvard Medical School — Molecular Biology
work.summary: Developed scalable 3D FIB-SEM and Cryo-ET analysis workflows to quantify mitochondrial morphology under varying oxygen conditions.
highlights: Developed and executed scalable 3D FIB-SEM image analysis pipelines to quantify mitochondrial and lipid droplet spatial distributions.
Reconstructed 250+ Cryo-ET datasets with Amira 3D and ImageJ to generate reproducible morphological metric differences in muscle cell differentiation.
Implemented surface morphometric feature extraction workflows in Unix/Linux and quantified membrane distance visualized in Python with Docker/Apptainer images for reproducibility.
Quantified five features from 500+ images across hypoxic and anoxic conditions with group statistical comparison.

work.name: Massachusetts General Hospital, Harvard Medical School — Molecular Pathology
work.summary: Applied AI/ML diffusion modeling and transcriptomic analyses for cancer biomarker confirmation.
highlights: Applied AI/ML diffusion models to predict fusion protein folding for small cell lung cancer in a Unix/Linux environment.
Analyzed 50+ snRNA-seq TCGA perturbation datasets of glioblastoma cell lines for gene mutational biomarker confirmation.
Performed statistical modeling and FDR hypothesis testing for 50+ gene effect scores associated with bulk RNA-seq, visualized in R.

work.name: Occidental College, Biology Department
work.summary: Investigated inflammatory mechanisms in human macrophage cultures infected with Group A Streptococcus.
highlights: Conducted experiments on increased inflammatory mechanisms in human macrophage cell cultures infected with Group A Streptococcus, resulting in identification of secreted cytotoxic proteins.
Harvested proteins to detect inflammation responses using ELISA and conducted protein identification via Western blot, contributing to immune response mechanism studies.
Executed mammalian cell culture for protein expression, followed by downstream protein extraction and analysis workflows.

work.name: Cap Consulting Institute
work.summary: Tutored and mentored students in STEM subjects and college applications.
highlights: Tutored 20 students in SAT Math, AP Biology, AP Chemistry, and SAT writing, tracking progress in Excel and driving near-perfect scores.
Proctored mock SAT exams for 100+ students to tailor lesson plans.
Led weekly personal statement workshops for 50+ students, achieving 100% college admission for participants.
